★ Request
Fade to black

■ Stage Direction
Same character as "Veteran Trainer A (Male)" from Episode 1.

That's why I'm the one who can make her shine the brightest...
I'm the one who's truly worthy of being her Trainer!

One day, while training with Super Creek
just like any other day—
Thank you, Tama-chan. I appreciate you lending a hand~
Oh, my. If it isn't you.

I may be a rookie, but I'm confident my desire to support
her is stronger than anyone else's.
There are times when wanting to dote on someone and take care of them is what keeps you going, you know.

I simply want to bring smiles to everyone's faces.
To the children at the daycare, to my Trainer...
With those parting words, the veteran trainer walked away.

Hold on a sec! Yer plannin' on pattin' my head, ain'tcha?!
I keep tellin' ya, I ain't a little kid!

Super Creek had been in great form lately,
flawlessly handling all the workouts I assigned.

Oh no, not at all~
I don't have the slightest intention of losing, after all~
Now then, let's do our best with our training~

The one calling out was the veteran trainer
who had tried to scout Super Creek during the selection race.
If we have our Umamusume race against each other, it should make it crystal clear who brings out her talent better.
...Tama-chan told me earlier that you're always quick to dote on people and pamper them, but...

Well, whatever your reasoning, you'll be transferring over to me either way.
I'll look forward to the race.

This new training regimen is wonderful.
It's very easy on the legs, too~

Indeed, if a trainer's duty is to put their Umamusume first,
then taking pride in being the most suited for them is only natural—
Ehehe, that's my Trainer for you♪

Of course you'll accept, right?
Assuming you really take pride in being the one most suited for Super Creek, that is.

You accepted because you're proud and confident
that you're the one most suited for me, right?

That I'm at my best when I'm with you...
Knowing you feel that way makes me so, so happy~♪
She's trying to live up to my feelings.

I didn't expect you to be the one answering.
Does that mean you're expressing your desire to transfer to my team?
In that case, I have to prove that I'm worthy!

So please don't look so worried, it's going to be okay.
I promise I will live up to your feelings.

In that case, if we win, you won't object to
Super Creek coming under my care, will you?
Ah, wait up, Tama-chan~

Hmm... My Trainer has been giving me training
that's perfectly tailored to me, but...
Of course, that's perfectly fine with me.

Ehehe, my Trainer came up with it.
They said doing tandem training that simulates a real race would be best.

And so, we continued our training in preparation for
the race against the veteran trainer's Umamusume.
Oh my~, Trainer♪
Now then, next up is a light dash on the dirt course~

Super Creek leaving...?! 
If that's the stake, there's no way I can accept this challenge—

Even if you're still a rookie,
I'll prove to everyone what a wonderful Trainer you truly are♪

Even though losing would mean a potential transfer,
she casually accepted the challenge without hesitation.

If you had teamed up with me, you would have
made your debut long ago...
Nah, pretty sure she just wants an excuse to spoil ya rotten.

Well, whatever. Gotta shut up that blockhead trainer
tryin' to poach ya without givin' a damn 'bout how an Umamusume feels anyway.

If all you do are such half-hearted workouts,
even debuting will remain a distant dream.
Oh dear, whatever shall we do...

It seems you are vastly overestimating this rookie trainer's capabilities.
...Very well, let us hold a mock race to make their true caliber clear.
Ehehe, there there, don't worry... It's all okay♪

Good work today, Trainer.
Tomorrow is finally the day of the race, isn't it~?
So yer askin' me to help out with her trainin', huh.
*huff*... *pant*... *sigh*...
